fix: Use the text-free accessor: `self.tree.text_field_input_geometry(field).is_some_and(|snapshot| snapshot.obscure_text)` here, and in `text_field_pointer_selection_enabled` (line 2234) replace `text_field_input_snapshot(field)` with `text_field_input_geometry(field)`. Both helpers only read read_only/obscure_text, so the full text copy of the field is wasted on every pointer event. Confirm the geometry snapshot carries those two flags (it is built by the same function with text left empty).

Make `dispatch_keyboard` (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/focus.rs:110) and `dispatch_keyboard_where` take `&KeyboardEvent`, and have `GestureCallbacks::handle_keyboard` take a reference, so the walk clones nothing. Then call `self.tree.dispatch_keyboard(self.focused, &event)` here. Today every key-down clones the keyboard_types event, which owns a String for character keys, and the ancestor walk clones it again per listener.

`platform_view_placements()` (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/retained.rs:1000) returns a fresh Vec every frame whenever a platform view is mounted. Have the tree fill a buffer owned by Runtime (e.g. `platform_view_placements_into(&self, out: &mut Vec<PlatformViewPlacement>)`), taking it with `std::mem::take` at the top of this fn and putting it back at the end so the vector is reused.

Change `platform_views` (field at line 170, constructed at line 330) to `BTreeMap<PlatformViewId, PlatformViewRecord>`; PlatformViewId already derives Ord. Then iterate in order without the Vec or the sort: `for record in self.platform_views.values_mut() { self.platform_view_commands.extend(record.controller.take_commands()); }`. Drop the `keys()` lookup as well.

`platform_views` is a HashMap, so the order in which hidden Place commands reach `platform_view_commands` changes from run to run. Switching the map to BTreeMap (see the collect_platform_view_commands finding) fixes this with the same change.

Hot-reload path only. The Vec is collected and iterated once, and nothing else borrows `self.builders` mutably in between, so iterate the chain directly: `let mut reactive = self.reactive.borrow_mut(); for id in root.into_iter().chain(self.builders.keys().copied().filter(|id| Some(*id) != root)) { ... }` and delete the `let ids` binding.

`focusable_elements()` (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/focus.rs:62) allocates a Vec on every Tab press. Add a tree method that returns the neighbour of `self.focused` in traversal order (`focus_neighbor(focused, reverse) -> Option<ElementId>`) or fills a Runtime-owned buffer, so focus_next does no allocation per event.
